items.title: 'We escaped Spanish wildfire, but our friends lost their lives'
items.description: Hundreds of firefighters in Spain have been battling a deadly wildfire in the south of the country.

items.title: Spain wildfire: Firefighters begin to contain deadly blaze
items.description: Firefighters have started to rein in the wildfire in Spain's southern Andalusia region that killed 12 people. The affected region is home to one of the largest expat communities.

items.title: How a fake presidential council ended up with a budget of almost $1m in Nigeria
items.description: The government says it was set up with a forged letter of appointment but others say there is more to it.

items.title: Landmark US housing bill becomes law despite Trump protest
items.description: The president had wanted voter ID legislation passed before the housing law, which aims to reduce costs and increase supply.

items.title: At Canada's biggest rodeo, the starting gun is fired in the fight over Alberta separation
items.description: Canadian unity takes centre stage at the Calgary Stampede as fears of a Brexit-style upset looms over the October vote on Alberta's future.

items.title: US: Trump looked to bypass federal election agency before firings, says report
items.description: The White House explored declaring a national emergency to address alleged vulnerabilities in voting machines before Trump ousted leaders of the Election Assistance Commission, a report has found.

items.title: Iran says Strait of Hormuz closed 'until further notice'
items.description: The IRGC says it fired a warning shot at a vessel in the strait and is warning the US not to respond with "aggression".
